purpose: De-identified local-book workflow samples retained across books workspace cleanup runs for fresh test and production starts.

classification_policy.success: K3-H, K3-L, K3-M, and the 2026-07-31 latest Lean sample: user-confirmed examples where the workflow principles were carried through or had no material workflow problem; prose is out of scope.
classification_policy.failure: DS and M3: user-confirmed examples of incomplete workflow execution caused by looping or bypassing; prose is out of scope.
classification_policy.control: All remaining books: incomplete test cases, not positive or negative benchmarks for either workflow or prose.
classification_policy.state_warning: A stored state such as ready is not used as a label. It can coexist with a failure sample when the historical control plane allowed a bypass.

retention_policy: Only de-identified aggregate metadata is retained. No novel text, title, slug, planning text, evidence content, local Git history, Guardian data, session identifier, hash, or model/provider data is copied into this sample set.

samples.workflow_interpretation: Workflow execution was incomplete because it bypassed steps or looped; this does not rate prose style.
samples.retention: Aggregates only; raw prose, planning, evidence payloads, local Git objects, Guardian material, identifiers, and hashes are intentionally excluded.
